scope:
HAL20 consolidated candidates with opt-in exact-artifact guard. No private dependencies published.
Engine/controller boundaries are modeled; not gameplay Windows certification.

checks.name: admission-matches-request
checks.details: Unsafe requested order must not enter controller.

checks.name: controller-derived-selection-cannot-change-consumption
checks.details: Test wrapper changes derived cursor/stack marks, while ABI selection/identities stay equal; reject before native collection.

checks.name: late-controller-quarantine-requires-new-duel
checks.details: No fake rollback or automatic stack/UI repair.

checks.name: reset-simulated-load-no-pending
checks.details: Registered buffers only; pending BSS not invented as savestate. Real reset/LOAD callbacks.

checks.name: new-duel-no-stale-pending
checks.details: Real MOD init-hook stack over modeled engine init, plus real reset; not gameplay/save certification.
